name: thesophiaxu/openttd-bench
title: OpenTTD-Bench: frontier agents run rival transport companies in real time; none beat the scripted AI yet
summary: Four agents share one seeded OpenTTD 15.3 game for ten game years (about 3 real hours) and are scored on operating profit through a Python client. GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra lead but still trail the AAAHogEx rules-based baseline; the writeup covers failure modes and how agents use subagents under time pressure. Code is open, built on Prime Intellect verifiers.
